paragraphs.text: Sukurvia is a desert in southern Jamuraa on Dominaria , located east of Palmyra and west of the Scarwood . In the west, the Sukurvia is bordered by the River Toloron , which divides it from the Western Wastes .

The Sukurvian Desert, also known as The Sands of the Sukurvia is infested with deadly wurms . There is an underground sea beneath Sukurvia named the Sunken Sea that surfaces in different places, creating oases that extend across the desert. Four tribes of cat warriors , the Efravans , Hooraree , Khyyiani , and Sulaki , live in these oases. The Sunken Sea also connected to Johan's Joy , the dammed lake at the edge of Palmyra , before the dam was destroyed and the lake drained away, and to the Blue Blanket , although that has been lost to the desert sands.
At some point, Sukurvia became host to vultures from the Osai Desert of Shandalar , likely through summoning or a planar portal which would have been closed during the Great Mending .
